projects.name: DelDOT CTP Capital Transportation Projects - P3E_WEB (lines)
projects.notes: Projects published to DelDOT's public project portal (one line per project). Also has PROJECTED_CONSTRUCTION_START / PROJECTED_CONSTRUCTION_FINISH text fields. DelDOT Capital Transportation Program projects from the Primavera/TSDM system via Delaware FirstMap. PHASE gives the current phase (planning/design/right-of-way/construction etc.) and PROJ_STATUS active/complete; each milestone date has a *_FLAG of 'Est' or 'Act' (ADV_DATE advertise, BID_DATE, AWD_DATE award, REAL_EST_DATE / REAL_EST_INIT_DATE real-estate acquisition milestones, COMP_DATE completion). Planned = ADV_DATE_FLAG 'Est' (not yet advertised) or PHASE before Construction. PROJECT_COST is a padded string. FINANCE_NO is the state contract number.

projects.name: DelDOT CTP Capital Transportation Projects - P3E_ALL_LINE
projects.notes: All project line segments including ones not published to the web portal (PUBLISH_ON_WEB, CTP_INDICATOR fields); many rows per project. Layers 1 (P3E_ALL_POINT) and 3 (P3E_ALL_POLYGONS) hold point and polygon project locations with the same schema. parcels_counties.notes: New Castle County government static tax-parcel snapshot dated 2026-03-13 (primary address + primary owner per parcel); CNTCTLAST is the owner name. LOTSZ is lot size (units not stated). The county's live server gis.nccde.org returned HTTP 572 to automated requests.
Kent County, DE live parcel layer; Name is the parcel number, Pride links to the county property record. TOTALASSESSMENT is assessed value.

summary: DelDOT CTP project layers on FirstMap carry phase, cost and estimated/actual milestone dates (including real-estate dates). The FirstMap statewide parcel layer (https://enterprise.firstmap.delaware.gov/arcgis/rest/services/PlanningCadastre/DE_StateParcels/FeatureServer/0, 454,893 parcels, verified) has only PIN, ACRES, COUNTY, so owners come from counties: New Castle (static 2026 snapshot) and Kent verified; Sussex County's 'ParcelsWithOwner' services exist but returned HTTP 403 to automated requests.
